1.question: How far (in blocks) can a redstone signal travel without a repeater?
1.funFact: A redstone signal loses strength with every block and dies out at 0. Repeaters restore it to full strength 15.

2.question: Which mob gives you endless mushroom stew when you milk it with a bowl?
2.funFact: Mooshrooms only spawn in mushroom fields biomes, one of the rarest biomes in Minecraft.

3.question: How many health points (half hearts) does a creeper have?
3.funFact: A charged creeper (struck by lightning) has the same health but deals double explosion damage.

4.question: How many health points (half hearts) does a zombie have?
4.funFact: Zombies burn in sunlight unless they wear a helmet or stand in the shade.

5.question: How many health points (half hearts) does a skeleton have?
5.funFact: Skeletons avoid wolves. They can shoot with bows enchanted up to Infinity.

6.question: How many health points (half hearts) does an enderman have?
6.funFact: Endermen take damage from water and rain. They teleport when they get wet.

7.question: How many health points (half hearts) does a blaze have?
7.funFact: Blazes take damage from snowballs; each hit deals 3 damage (1.5 hearts).

8.question: How many health points (half hearts) does a ghast have?
8.funFact: You can deflect ghast fireballs and kill the ghast with them (advancement: Return to Sender).

9.question: How many health points (half hearts) does a wither skeleton have?
9.funFact: Wither skeletons inflict the Wither effect when they hit you. Their skull is needed to summon the Wither.

10.question: How many health points (half hearts) does the Wither (boss) have in the Java Edition?
10.funFact: The Wither has 300 health points in the Java Edition and 600 in the Bedrock Edition. It is the only boss you can summon yourself.

11.question: How many health points (half hearts) does the Ender Dragon have?
11.funFact: The Ender Dragon is healed by end crystals on the obsidian pillars. Destroy them first!

12.question: How many health points (half hearts) does an elder guardian have?
12.funFact: When you come close, the elder guardian gives you the Mining Fatigue III effect for 5 minutes.

13.question: How many health points (half hearts) does a Warden have?
13.funFact: The Warden is blind and navigates only by vibrations. One hit on Normal deals 30 health points of damage.

14.question: How many health points (half hearts) does an iron golem have?
14.funFact: Iron golems can be healed by clicking them with iron ingots (25 health points per ingot).

15.question: How many health points (half hearts) does a ravager have?
15.funFact: Ravagers can be attacked by bees, wolves and iron golems and stun players on impact.

16.question: How many health points (half hearts) does a strider have?
16.funFact: Striders are the only mobs that walk on lava. You ride them with a warped fungus on a stick.

17.question: How many health points (half hearts) does a hoglin have?
17.funFact: Hoglins are afraid of warped fungi. They drop raw porkchop and leather.

18.question: How many health points (half hearts) does a witch have?
18.funFact: Witches drink potions to heal themselves and throw potions at players. They spawn in witch huts in swamps.

19.question: How many health points (half hearts) does a large slime have?
19.funFact: Large slimes split into medium ones (4 health points) when they die, and these into small ones (1 health point). Small slimes drop slimeballs.

20.question: How many health points (half hearts) does a large magma cube have?
20.funFact: Magma cubes are immune to fall damage and fire. Small magma cubes drop magma cream.

21.question: How many health points (half hearts) does a shulker have?
21.funFact: Shulker projectiles cause Levitation for 10 seconds. Shulkers can teleport when attacked.

22.question: How many health points (half hearts) does a pillager have?
22.funFact: Killing a pillager captain (with a banner) gives you the Bad Omen effect, which triggers a raid.

23.question: How many health points (half hearts) does an evoker have?
23.funFact: Evokers summon vexes and fang attacks. They are the only source of totems of undying.

24.question: How many health points (half hearts) does a bee have?
24.funFact: After stinging, the bee loses its stinger and dies after a short time. It poisons the player.

25.question: How many health points (half hearts) does a phantom have?
25.funFact: Phantoms spawn when you have not slept for 3 or more Minecraft days (72 real minutes). Cats scare them away.

27.question: How many blocks wide is a chunk (X axis)?
27.funFact: Chunks are 16x16 blocks and 384 blocks tall (from Y=-64 to Y=320). A chunk has 98,304 blocks.

28.question: At which Y level does diamond ore spawn most often (since 1.18)?
28.funFact: Since Caves & Cliffs (1.18), Y=-58 is the optimum. Diamonds generate from Y=-64 to Y=16 but pile up deep down.

29.question: How much XP does the Ender Dragon give on the first kill?
29.funFact: That is by far the most XP a mob can give. Further kills only give 500 XP.

30.question: How much XP does killing a Wither give?
30.funFact: Although the Wither is very strong, it only gives 50 XP, much less than the Ender Dragon.

31.question: How long does it take to mine an obsidian block with a diamond pickaxe (seconds)?
31.funFact: With Efficiency V and a netherite pickaxe it takes only about 1.15 seconds.

32.question: How long does it take to mine an obsidian block with bare hands (seconds)?
32.funFact: Mining obsidian by hand takes over 4 minutes, and the block does not even drop as an item!

33.question: How many torches can you craft with one stick and one coal?
33.funFact: Charcoal works just like coal for crafting torches. A recipe always gives 4 torches.

34.question: How many arrows can you craft with 1 flint, 1 stick and 1 feather?
34.funFact: Arrows can also be dropped by skeletons. With Looting III up to 5 per kill.

35.question: How many planks do you get from one log?
35.funFact: Planks are one of the most basic resources; almost all early tools and furniture need them.

36.question: How many sticks do you get from 2 planks?
36.funFact: Sticks are the universal tool ingredient: for swords, pickaxes, shovels, axes, bows and more.

37.question: What is the maximum level of the Sharpness enchantment?
37.funFact: Sharpness V adds 3 extra half hearts of damage. With a netherite sword: 13 damage in total.

38.question: What is the maximum level of the Protection enchantment?
38.funFact: Protection IV reduces incoming damage by 16 percent. Four full armor pieces with Protection IV = 64 percent damage reduction.

39.question: What is the maximum level of the Fortune enchantment?
39.funFact: Fortune III can increase the diamond yield from 1 to up to 4 per ore.

40.question: What is the maximum level of the Efficiency enchantment?
40.funFact: Efficiency V with a netherite pickaxe and Haste II is the fastest possible mining speed in the vanilla game.

41.question: What is the maximum level of the Mending enchantment?
41.funFact: Mending cannot be obtained at an enchanting table, only from loot, trading or fishing.

42.question: What is the maximum level of the Infinity enchantment?
42.funFact: Infinity requires at least 1 arrow in your inventory but creates unlimited arrows. It is incompatible with Mending.

43.question: What is the maximum level of the Looting enchantment?
43.funFact: Looting III increases the maximum drop count of rare items by 3. Essential for farming wither skeleton skulls.

44.question: How long does coal burn as furnace fuel (seconds)?
44.funFact: One coal smelts 8 items. A block of coal (9 coal) smelts 72 items.

45.question: How long does a block of coal burn as furnace fuel (seconds)?
45.funFact: A block of coal smelts 80 items, 10 times more than a single coal.

46.question: How long does it take to smelt an item in a normal furnace (seconds)?
46.funFact: A blast furnace smelts ores twice as fast (5 s) but also uses twice as much fuel.

47.question: What light level does a torch have?
47.funFact: Torches have light level 14. The maximum light level (15) is held by glowstone, lanterns and sea pickles, for example.

48.question: What is the minimum light level that prevents monsters from spawning (since 1.18)?
48.funFact: Since 1.18, monsters only spawn at light level 0. Before that it was light level 7.

49.question: How many slots does the player inventory have in total (including hotbar, armor and off hand)?
49.funFact: 27 main inventory + 9 hotbar + 4 armor + 1 off hand = 41 slots.

50.question: How many items fit into one stack at most?
50.funFact: Tools, armor and some items do not stack or only up to 16. Boats stack only up to 1.

51.question: How long does a Potion of Swiftness II last (seconds)?
51.funFact: Swiftness II increases movement speed by 20 percent. Swiftness I lasts 180 seconds.

52.question: How long does a Potion of Strength I last (seconds)?
52.funFact: Strength I increases melee damage by 3 (1.5 hearts). Strength II increases it by 6 but lasts only 90 s.

53.question: How long does a Potion of Regeneration I last (seconds)?
53.funFact: Regeneration I heals 1 health point every 2.5 seconds. Regeneration II heals 1 health point every second.

54.question: How long does a Potion of Fire Resistance last (seconds)?
54.funFact: Fire Resistance protects against lava, fire and blaze fireballs, essential for exploring the Nether.

55.question: Which ingredient turns a splash potion into a lingering potion?
55.funFact: You collect dragon's breath with an empty bottle by catching the Ender Dragon's acid cloud.

56.question: Which mob in the nether fortress drops rods used to make fuel for the brewing stand?
56.funFact: Blaze rods are essential for brewing stands and eyes of ender. Without them the final fight cannot be reached.

57.question: Which mob drops ender pearls?
57.funFact: Ender pearls have a 50 percent drop chance per enderman. With Looting III up to 4 per kill.

58.question: Which bouncing green cube mob drops balls used to craft sticky pistons?
58.funFact: Slimes spawn in swamps at full moon or in slime chunks below Y=40. Slimeballs are needed for pistons.

59.question: Which white floating mob of the Nether, which shoots fireballs, drops tears?
59.funFact: Ghast tears are the base for Regeneration potions. The drop chance is only 30 percent, with Looting III up to 4.

60.question: Which mob drops magma cream?
60.funFact: Magma cream is needed for Fire Resistance potions. Only small and medium magma cubes drop it.

61.question: How many ancient debris do you need for one netherite ingot?
61.funFact: 4 ancient debris -> 4 netherite scrap -> 4 scrap + 4 gold ingots = 1 netherite ingot.

62.question: How many netherite ingots do you need for a complete set of netherite armor?
62.funFact: Each armor piece needs 1 netherite ingot + the matching diamond piece at the smithing table.

63.question: How many armor points does a diamond chestplate give?
63.funFact: The chestplate gives the most armor points. Helmet: 3, leggings: 6, boots: 3, chestplate: 8.

64.question: How many eyes of ender do you need for a complete end portal frame?
64.funFact: In strongholds 0 to 12 eyes are already inserted (random). Sometimes you only need to place a few.

65.question: How many strongholds are there in a Minecraft world (Java Edition)?
65.funFact: Strongholds spawn in rings around the world center. The first 3 are closest, up to 128 in total.

66.question: What is the ratio: 1 block in the Nether = how many blocks in the Overworld (X/Z axis)?
66.funFact: The 1:8 ratio makes the Nether the perfect highway. 1000 blocks in the Nether = 8000 blocks of Overworld distance!

67.question: How many blocks tall is the Overworld in total (lowest to highest Y level)?
67.funFact: From Y=-64 (lowest bedrock) to Y=320 (highest build limit) = 384 blocks of height. Before 1.18 it was only 256.

68.question: Which block is unbreakable in survival mode?
68.funFact: Bedrock is unbreakable in survival mode. It exists at the bottom of the Overworld, the Nether and everywhere in the End.

69.question: How many layers of bedrock are there at the bottom of the Overworld?
69.funFact: The 5 bedrock layers (Y=-64 to Y=-60) are randomly distributed.

70.question: How many bookshelves do you need to place around a table for maximum enchantments?
70.funFact: The bookshelves must be 1 block away from the table. Blocks in between block the bonus.

71.question: How many books do you need for one bookshelf?
71.funFact: One bookshelf = 6 planks + 3 books. For 15 bookshelves you need 45 books = 135 paper + 45 leather.

72.question: How many lapis lazuli does the most expensive enchantment at the enchanting table cost?
72.funFact: The most expensive enchantment costs 3 lapis lazuli and 30 experience levels.

73.question: How many diamonds do you need for a diamond pickaxe?
73.funFact: A diamond pickaxe has 1561 durability. Netherite pickaxe: 2031. Both can mine obsidian.

74.question: How many diamonds do you need for a diamond sword?
74.funFact: A diamond sword deals 7 damage (3.5 hearts). A netherite sword deals 8 damage (4 hearts).

75.question: How many different villager professions are there?
75.funFact: 13 professions: armorer, butcher, cartographer, cleric, farmer, fisherman, fletcher, leatherworker, librarian, mason, shepherd, toolsmith, weaponsmith.

76.question: Which workstation is used by the librarian villager?
76.funFact: The lectern also allows sharing written books with several players.

77.question: Which workstation is used by the cleric?
77.funFact: Clerics trade redstone dust, lapis lazuli, glowstone, nether wart and totems of undying.

78.question: How many nether wart do you need as a base for every potion?
78.funFact: Nether wart in the brewing stand with water gives an awkward potion, the base for ALL useful potions.

79.question: How long does a Minecraft day last in total (in real minutes)?
79.funFact: 1 Minecraft day = 20 real minutes: 10 min day, 1.5 min dusk, 7 min night.

80.question: How far can water flow on flat ground (blocks)?
80.funFact: Water spreads up to 7 blocks from the source. Into a depression it keeps flowing downward.

81.question: How far does lava flow on flat ground in the Overworld (blocks)?
81.funFact: In the Nether lava flows 7 blocks, in the Overworld only 3 blocks.

82.question: What is the minimum distance (in blocks) at which mobs spawn from the player?
82.funFact: Mobs spawn between 24 and 128 blocks from the player. Closer than 24: no spawn. Farther than 128: they despawn instantly.

83.question: On which block must nether wart be planted?
83.funFact: Nether wart only grows on soul sand, whether in the Nether or in the Overworld.

84.question: How many sugar cane do you need for 1 paper?
84.funFact: 3 sugar cane side by side in the crafting table = 3 paper. Paper is needed for maps, books and fireworks.

85.question: How tall does sugar cane grow at most (blocks)?
85.funFact: Sugar cane only grows on grass, dirt, sand or red sand directly next to water.

86.question: How many different colors of wool are there in Minecraft?
86.funFact: The 16 colors match the 16 dye variants: white, orange, magenta, light blue, yellow, lime, pink, gray, light gray, cyan, purple, blue, brown, green, red, black.

88.question: How do you get a music disc dropped by a creeper?
88.funFact: When a skeleton's arrow kills a creeper, it drops one of 13 different discs (random).

89.question: How many blocks can a piston push in a line?
89.funFact: A piston can push at most 12 blocks. With slime blocks, structures can be moved as a unit.

90.question: How many redstone ticks does a repeater delay at maximum setting?
90.funFact: One redstone tick = 2 game ticks = 0.1 seconds. A repeater on setting 4 delays the signal by 0.4 seconds.

91.question: How many slots does a hopper have?
91.funFact: Hoppers transport items at 2.5 items per second. They can be pointed downward or sideways.

92.question: What is the maximum build height in Minecraft (Y level)?
92.funFact: Build height: Y=320. Clouds are at Y=192. Before 1.18 the maximum height was Y=255.

93.question: How many scutes do you need for a turtle shell?
93.funFact: The turtle shell gives 2 armor points and +10 seconds of water breathing.

94.question: What do baby turtles drop when they grow up?
94.funFact: 5 scutes = 1 turtle shell. It gives you water breathing for a short time when you are in water.

95.question: How many gold ingots do you need for a normal golden apple?
95.funFact: 8 gold ingots + 1 apple = golden apple. The enchanted one (Notch apple) can no longer be crafted.

96.question: How many gold blocks were needed in the past for an enchanted golden apple (Notch apple)?
96.funFact: 8 gold blocks (72 gold ingots!) + 1 apple = Notch apple. The recipe was removed in 1.9.

97.question: Which mob is turned into a zombified piglin by lightning?
97.funFact: Lightning strikes turn pigs into zombified piglins, villagers into witches and creepers into charged creepers.

99.question: How many obsidian blocks do you need at least for a nether portal?
99.funFact: The mini portal is 4x5 blocks. The corners are optional, hence 10 instead of 14.

100.question: How many diamonds do you need for a complete set of diamond armor?

101.question: How many slots does a double chest have?
101.funFact: A double chest holds 54x64 = 3456 items (maximum). It is created automatically when you place 2 chests next to each other.

102.question: How many slots does an ender chest have?
102.funFact: The contents of an ender chest are tied to the player and accessible from anywhere in the world.

103.question: How many obsidian blocks do you need for an ender chest?
103.funFact: 8 obsidian + 1 eye of ender = ender chest. It has the same blast protection as obsidian.

104.question: Which item do you need to ride a strider in the Nether?
104.funFact: You combine a fishing rod with a warped fungus. The strider walks toward the held fungus.

106.question: How many health points (half hearts) does an axolotl have?
106.funFact: Axolotls play dead when they take damage. They attack guardians!

107.question: How many health points (half hearts) does a camel have?
107.funFact: Camels spawn in desert villages, can carry 2 players and dash across gaps 2 blocks wide.

108.question: How many health points (half hearts) does a goat have?
108.funFact: Goats ram players and mobs. Screaming goats are rarer.

109.question: How many health points (half hearts) does a piglin brute have?
109.funFact: Piglin brutes always attack, even if you wear golden armor.

110.question: How many health points (half hearts) does a zoglin have?
110.funFact: Zoglins appear when hoglins are taken into the Overworld or the End. They attack everything except creepers.

111.question: How many color variants does an axolotl have?
111.funFact: Axolotl colors: leucistic (white), wild (brown), gold (yellow), cyan and rarely blue (1 in 1200 chance when breeding).

112.question: How many frog variants are there in Minecraft 1.19+?
112.funFact: 3 frog colors: temperate (orange), warm (white), cold (green). The biome where the tadpole grows up decides the color.

113.question: Which rare block is created when a frog eats a small magma cube?
113.funFact: There are 3 froglight colors (ochre, verdant, pearlescent), depending on the frog variant. All have light level 15.

114.question: How much damage does a Warden attack deal on Normal (half hearts)?
114.funFact: The Warden deals 30 damage on Normal (15 hearts). On Hard: 45 damage!

115.question: How far can the Warden shoot its sonic boom (blocks)?
115.funFact: The sonic boom completely bypasses armor and shields! It deals 10 damage regardless of armor.

116.question: How many shrieks must you trigger in the Deep Dark before a Warden spawns?
116.funFact: A Warden only appears after the fourth shriek of a sculk shrieker. Sneaking prevents vibrations.

117.question: Which block can block vibrations and blind sculk sensors?
117.funFact: Wool blocks absorb vibration signals and stop sculk sensors from detecting sounds through them.

119.question: What is the maximum Y coordinate of ancient debris spawns?
119.funFact: Ancient debris spawns between Y=8 and Y=119, most often at Y=15.

122.question: How many fireballs does a blaze shoot in one attack burst?
122.funFact: Blazes always shoot 3 fireballs in quick succession, then pause briefly. Snowballs are the cheapest counter.

125.question: How many hearts of absorption does a normal golden apple give?
125.funFact: A normal golden apple gives Regeneration II (5 s) and Absorption I (2 min = 2 extra hearts).

126.question: Which helpful blue mob from 1.19 won the mob vote of 2021?
126.funFact: The allay collects items for the player and dances to note blocks. It can be duplicated with an amethyst shard.

128.question: How many ticks per second (TPS) does a normal Minecraft server have?
128.funFact: One game tick lasts 0.05 seconds. Redstone repeaters work in multiples of 1 tick (0.1 s per tick delay).

129.question: How many slots does a dispenser have?
129.funFact: Dispensers can throw or use almost all items: shoot arrows, empty or fill buckets, pour potions.

130.question: How many health points (half hearts) does a sniffer have?
130.funFact: The sniffer won the 2022 mob vote. It digs up ancient seeds (torchflower, pitcher plant).

132.question: How many health points (half hearts) does a vindicator have?
132.funFact: Vindicators are the most dangerous pillager mobs. With an axe they deal up to 19 damage per hit on Hard.

133.question: How many health points (half hearts) does a drowned have?
133.funFact: Drowned spawn in water or appear when zombies stay underwater too long. They sometimes drop tridents.

134.question: How many health points (half hearts) does a husk have?
134.funFact: Husks only spawn in deserts. Their attack causes the Hunger effect instead of direct damage.

135.question: How many health points (half hearts) does a stray have?
135.funFact: Strays are skeleton variants from snowy biomes. Their arrows cause Slowness I for 30 seconds.

136.question: How many health points (half hearts) does a zombie villager have?
136.funFact: Zombie villagers can be cured with a Potion of Weakness and a golden apple (2 to 5 minutes).

137.question: How many bones do you need on average to tame a wolf?
137.funFact: The success chance per bone is 1/3. On average 3 bones, but it can also take 1 or 10.

138.question: How much XP do you need for level 1?
138.funFact: The XP cost per level rises: levels 1 to 16 cost 7 to 17 XP each. From level 31 you need over 100 XP per level.

139.question: What light level does a glowstone block have?
139.funFact: Light level 15 is the maximum in Minecraft. Glowstone, shroomlight, campfire and sea pickle all have 15.

140.question: How many wheat do you need to breed 2 cows?
140.funFact: Cows, sheep and mooshrooms are bred with wheat. The calf grows up after 20 minutes.

141.question: How many cocoa beans do you get from a ripe cocoa pod?
141.funFact: Cocoa pods only grow on jungle logs and have 3 growth stages. When ripe they are brown.

142.question: Which block creates a rising column of bubbles underwater?
142.funFact: Soul sand creates rising bubbles. Magma blocks create a sinking water current, ideal for elevators!

143.question: How many layers (slices) does a cake have in total?
143.funFact: Each slice of cake restores 2 hunger points. A whole cake gives 14 hunger points.

144.question: Which mob drops feathers?
144.funFact: Chickens drop 0 to 2 feathers on death. With Looting III up to 5 feathers. Feathers are needed for arrows.

147.question: Which workstation is used by the armorer?
147.funFact: The blast furnace smelts ores twice as fast as a normal furnace but cannot cook food.

148.question: How many diamonds does a diamond ore block drop at most (without an enchantment)?
148.funFact: With Fortune III, a single diamond ore block can drop up to 4 diamonds.

153.question: How much durability does a golden sword have?
153.funFact: Golden tools are the most fragile (32) but fastest tools. They are only really worth it with Fortune.

154.question: How many snowballs fit into one stack at most?
154.funFact: Snowballs stack to 16, not 64. Ender pearls also stack to 16.

155.question: How much damage does a snowball deal to a blaze?
155.funFact: Snowballs normally deal no damage, except against blazes (1.5 hearts) and the Ender Dragon.

156.question: Which item is needed to craft a bookshelf?
156.funFact: 3 books + 6 planks = 1 bookshelf. A bookshelf raises the maximum enchantment level by 2.

157.question: How much leather do you need for a complete set of leather armor?
157.funFact: Helmet: 5, chestplate: 8, leggings: 7, boots: 4, which makes 24 leather for the full set.

158.question: How many iron ingots do you need for a complete set of iron armor?
158.funFact: Helmet (5), chestplate (8), leggings (7), boots (4): exactly 24 ingots, the same as for leather, gold and diamond armor.

159.question: How much durability do leather boots have?
159.funFact: Leather armor: helmet 55, chestplate 80, leggings 75, boots 65, the weakest armor class in the game.

160.question: How many shots can a bow fire (without an enchantment)?
160.funFact: A bow has 384 durability. With Infinity you shoot endlessly but still need at least 1 arrow in your inventory.

164.question: What is the maximum signal strength a comparator outputs?
164.funFact: Comparators measure container fill levels and output 0 to 15 as a signal. A full chest gives 15.

166.question: How many redstone torches do you get from 1 redstone dust + 1 stick?
166.funFact: 1 stick + 1 redstone = 1 redstone torch. They emit light level 7 and invert redstone signals.

167.question: How long does a stone pressure plate stay active after being released (seconds)?
167.funFact: Stone pressure plates stay active for about 1 second. Wooden pressure plates stay active as long as a player or mob stands on them.

168.question: How many hearts does a player have by default?
168.funFact: 10 hearts = 20 health points. With the Absorption effect (golden apples), temporary yellow bonus hearts can be added.

169.question: From how many blocks of fall height does a player take damage?
169.funFact: Only from 4 blocks of fall height is there damage. Feathers, water, slime blocks and hay bales absorb fall damage completely.

172.question: For how long does a player burn after touching lava (seconds)?
172.funFact: Lava gives a 15-second fire debuff. With a Fire Resistance potion you can swim in lava without trouble.

173.question: How much damage does fall damage deal per block from the 4th block on?
173.funFact: From the 4th block: 1 damage per block. 23 blocks of fall height kill a player without armor (20 health points).

176.question: Which ingredient turns a potion into a splash potion?
176.funFact: Gunpowder turns any potion into a splash potion. Dragon's breath turns it into a lingering potion.

177.question: Which ingredient extends the duration of a potion?
177.funFact: Redstone extends the duration. Glowstone intensifies the effect (level II) but shortens the duration considerably.

178.question: Which ingredient is brewed into a Potion of Weakness (directly from water)?
178.funFact: Weakness is the only potion without the nether wart base potion. Ideal for curing zombie villagers.

185.question: Which villager sells enchanted books?
185.funFact: Librarians are the most valuable villagers: they can sell Mending and other rare books.

188.question: How many wool blocks do you need for a bed?
188.funFact: 3 wool + 3 planks = 1 bed. All wool blocks must be the same color. Beds explode in the Nether and the End!

189.question: How many planks do you need for a chest?
189.funFact: 8 planks (ring shape) = 1 chest with 27 slots. Two side by side form a double chest with 54 slots.

192.question: How many iron ingots do you need for an anvil?
192.funFact: 3 iron blocks (27 ingots) + 4 single ingots = anvil. It wears out after about 25 repairs.

193.question: How many blaze rods do you need for a brewing stand?
193.funFact: 1 blaze rod + 3 cobblestone = brewing stand. Blaze powder also burns as fuel (20 brewing operations).

195.question: How deep does the world go in Minecraft since 1.18 (lowest Y level)?
195.funFact: Since 1.18 (Caves & Cliffs) the world goes down to Y=-64. Bedrock starts at about Y=-64 up to Y=-60.

200.question: How many end crystals are there in the Ender Dragon fight?
200.funFact: 10 obsidian pillars, each with one end crystal on top. The crystals heal the dragon: destroy them first, then fight!

202.question: How many wither skeleton skulls do you need to summon the Wither?
202.funFact: 3 wither skulls + 4 soul sand/soul soil = Wither. Skulls drop from wither skeletons with about a 2.5% chance.

206.question: How many medium slimes are created at most when a large slime dies?
206.funFact: A large slime splits into 2 to 4 medium ones, and these into small ones. Small slimes drop 0 to 2 slimeballs. They only spawn in certain chunks.

207.question: How many blocks away can skeletons attack players?
207.funFact: Skeletons attack from up to 16 blocks away with bows. On high difficulty the arrow leads moving targets.

208.question: How much XP does a blaze drop on death?
208.funFact: Blazes give 10 XP, one of the highest amounts among Nether mobs. Blaze rods are essential for brewing.

621.question: What is the chance of a blue axolotl (approx.)?
621.funFact: The chance of a blue axolotl is 1/1200 = about 0.083%.

623.question: How many rabbit variants are there?
623.funFact: Rabbits come in 7 variants: brown, white, black, black and white, gold, salt and pepper and the killer bunny.

624.question: What percentage of all zombies spawn as baby zombies?
624.funFact: 5% of all zombies spawn as baby zombies.

625.question: How long do piglins trade after a gold throw?

626.question: How many different variants does a cat have?
626.funFact: Cats come in 11 color variants in Minecraft.

628.question: How many eggs do you have to throw to spawn a chicken (statistically)?

630.question: What honey level must a beehive have before you can harvest it?
630.funFact: Beehives must reach honey level 5 to be harvested.

636.question: Which mob gives the most XP on death?

637.question: Which mob causes Mining Fatigue?
637.funFact: Elder guardians give Mining Fatigue III in a large radius.

638.question: Which mob can pass through walls and floors?
638.funFact: Vexes can fly through solid blocks.

639.question: Which mob transforms when it reaches the Overworld?
639.funFact: Hoglins turn into zoglins as soon as they reach the Overworld.

640.question: Which mob can pick up certain blocks?

641.question: Which mob spawns when you have not slept for 3 days?
641.funFact: Phantoms spawn after 3 or more in-game days without sleeping.

642.question: Which mob can infect villagers?
642.funFact: Zombies can infect villagers and turn them into zombie villagers.

643.question: Which pet automatically protects its owner?
643.funFact: Tamed wolves attack mobs that attack their owner.

646.question: Which mob heals itself with a potion at low health?
646.funFact: Witches drink healing potions when their health is low.

647.question: Which mob shoots 3 skulls at once?
647.funFact: The Wither shoots 3 wither skulls at once.

648.question: What was Minecraft called in the very first development phase, before it got its current name?
648.funFact: Markus Persson first simply called his project Cave Game. The name Minecraft came shortly before the first public version.

649.question: In which year was the very first public test version of Minecraft released?
649.funFact: The first version was an early Classic test in May 2009. Full version 1.0 only followed in November 2011.

650.question: For how many billion US dollars did Microsoft buy the studio Mojang?
650.funFact: The 2014 purchase was one of the biggest acquisitions in gaming history, and Notch left the project afterwards.

651.question: From which mob model did the creeper come about through a programming mistake?
651.funFact: Notch swapped the length and height of a pig while modeling. The result was an upright, four-legged figure he kept.

652.question: What is the name of the second official default skin next to Steve, added in version 1.8?
652.funFact: Alex has slimmer arms than Steve and is today only one of nine default skins.

653.question: How many default skins are there since version 1.19.3 for players without their own skin?
653.funFact: Besides Steve and Alex, seven more characters with their own names were added.

654.question: Under which artist name does Daniel Rosenfeld publish the Minecraft music?
654.funFact: His albums Volume Alpha and Beta are known worldwide, although he only wrote the music, not the game.

655.question: What is the first name of the Minecraft creator the community calls “Notch”?
655.funFact: Markus Persson is a Swedish developer. He has used the nickname Notch since his early days in online forums.

656.question: Under which player name is developer Jens Bergensten known?
656.funFact: He took over leading the development from Notch and is behind the rainbow sheep easter egg.

657.question: What must a sheep be named with a name tag for its wool to constantly change color?
657.funFact: This is an easter egg for developer Jens Bergensten. The wool flashes through all 16 colors.

658.question: Which name on the name tag turns mobs upside down (name of a Mojang developer)?
658.funFact: The name Grumm also works. Both come from Mojang developers who let mobs walk upside down through the world.

659.question: What must a rabbit be named to get a special white texture that goes back to a pet?
659.funFact: The rabbit Toast belonged to a player. Mojang added its own texture in his honor.

660.question: What is the famous player legend with empty white eyes called that, according to Mojang, never existed in the game?
660.funFact: Some patch notes contain the sentence that Herobrine was removed. This is a running gag for over ten years.

661.question: What is the probability (in percent) that a naturally spawned sheep is pink?
661.funFact: Pink sheep are extremely rare. White wool is the rule at about 82 percent.

662.question: Which item on your head prevents endermen from getting angry when you look at them?
662.funFact: A carved pumpkin blocks the view, so players often wear it in enderman farms.

663.question: Which food is deadly for parrots?
663.funFact: Parrots can be tamed with seeds, but a cookie means instant death.

664.question: Which mob dances when a jukebox plays music nearby?
664.funFact: Parrots bob to the beat and even imitate the sounds of nearby mobs.

665.question: What percentage of goats are screaming goats?
665.funFact: Screaming goats jump higher, ram more often and have their own goat horn sounds.

666.question: How much durability do elytra (wings) have?
666.funFact: It is repaired with phantom membrane. The durability is gone quickly if you constantly crash into walls.

667.question: What do you use to repair elytra at an anvil?
667.funFact: The membrane drops from phantoms, which only appear when you do not sleep for too long.

668.question: Which mob drops a totem of undying?
668.funFact: It appears in woodland mansions and raids. The totem saves its owner from death and heals them.

669.question: Which mob can drop a trident with a bit of luck?
669.funFact: Only drowned that carry a trident in their hand drop it with a low probability.

670.question: Which flower is created when a Wither kills a mob?
670.funFact: It harms anyone who touches it. It can only be planted on a few blocks.

671.question: How many water blocks can a sponge soak up at most?
671.funFact: It soaks up water within a certain distance and can be dried in the furnace.

672.question: How many seconds does activated TNT burn before it explodes?
672.funFact: That is 80 ticks. Plenty of time to run away if you know what is coming.

673.question: From which level does the anvil show “Too Expensive!” in survival mode?
673.funFact: The price rises with every repair. If you combine cleverly, you avoid the limit.

674.question: How many experience points does a bottle o' enchanting give at most when it breaks?
674.funFact: There are between 3 and 11 points per bottle, a random value.

675.question: How many moon phases are there in Minecraft?
675.funFact: The moon phase changes, among other things, the chance of slimes in swamps and the difficulty of the region.

676.question: What percentage of all chunks are slime chunks (in the Overworld)?
676.funFact: Slime chunks depend on the world seed. Players look for them for slimeball farms below Y 40.

677.question: What turns a red mooshroom into a brown one?
677.funFact: A brown mooshroom gives different flower effects when you feed it flowers.

678.question: Into which mob does lightning turn a villager?
678.funFact: This is a reason to protect villages with lightning rods during thunderstorms.

679.question: What turns a creeper into a charged creeper?
679.funFact: Charged creepers have bigger explosions, and mobs killed by them drop their heads.

680.question: On which difficulty can zombies break wooden doors?
680.funFact: On Hard they can smash wooden doors and so enter houses.

681.question: How long does the Bad Omen effect last in minutes?
681.funFact: You get it after killing a pillager captain. If you then enter a village, it triggers a raid.

682.question: How many waves does a raid have on Normal difficulty?
682.funFact: It is three on Easy and seven on Hard.

683.question: What explodes when you try to sleep in the Nether?
683.funFact: The Nether counts as a dangerous environment, so the bed blows up. A respawn anchor is the right alternative.

684.question: How many items can a block of dried kelp smelt in a furnace?
684.funFact: The block burns for 200 seconds. Kelp farms are therefore popular in survival worlds.

685.question: With what percent probability does rotten flesh trigger the Hunger effect?
685.funFact: The effect lasts 30 seconds. Dogs, on the other hand, eat rotten flesh without problems.

686.question: How many different pitches can a note block produce?
686.funFact: It is two octaves. The sound depends on the block underneath.

687.question: How many disc fragments do you need to craft the music disc “5”?
687.funFact: The fragments are found in ancient cities in the deep dark.

688.question: How many copper ingots do you need for a spyglass?
688.funFact: An amethyst shard is also needed. The spyglass allows strong zooming in.

689.question: How many buckets of milk do you need for a cake?
689.funFact: In addition you need 2 sugar, 1 egg and 3 wheat. You get the empty buckets back.

690.question: How many eggs fit into a stack?
690.funFact: Snowballs and ender pearls also stack only up to 16. Most items up to 64.

691.question: How many llamas accompany a wandering trader?
691.funFact: The llamas carry leads. The trader disappears again after some time.

692.question: With what percent probability does a thrown eye of ender break?
692.funFact: In the other 80 percent the eye drops to the ground again and can be picked up.

693.question: Which area of extremely distorted terrain begins at about 12.5 million blocks distance?
693.funFact: Since version 1.18 they no longer exist in Java; they have disappeared from world generation.

694.question: How high can the best horse jump at most (in blocks)?
694.funFact: It easily jumps over fences and walls.

695.question: What was the Bedrock Edition for smartphones originally called?
695.funFact: The name was later replaced by Bedrock Edition, which unites the platforms.

696.question: Which mob flees from cats?
696.funFact: Creepers run away from cats and ocelots, which makes cats perfect housemates.

697.question: Which animal does a baby zombie sometimes ride as a so-called jockey?
697.funFact: The chicken jockey is rare but feared because it is small, fast and hard to hit.

698.question: How many end crystals do you need to summon the Ender Dragon again?
698.funFact: They are placed on the four sides of the exit portal.

699.question: Which item does a baby panda sometimes sneeze out?
699.funFact: Pandas sneeze randomly. The slimeball is a rare bonus you otherwise only get from slimes.

700.question: Which item does the Ender Dragon drop only once, on the first kill?
700.funFact: You cannot mine it without it teleporting. It exists only once per world.

701.question: Which animal is infertile and comes from breeding a horse and a donkey?
701.funFact: Mules cannot reproduce. They still carry a chest around with them.

702.question: How many slots does a brewing stand have in total (3 bottles, ingredient, fuel)?
702.funFact: Three slots for bottles, one for the ingredient and one for blaze powder as fuel. Hoppers can fill it automatically.

703.question: How many in-game days does a complete moon phase cycle last?
703.funFact: At full moon more slimes spawn in swamps and horses become more common; at new moon it is darkest.

704.question: How many ticks does a complete Minecraft day have?
704.funFact: At 20 ticks per second that is exactly 1200 seconds, so 20 minutes. Tick 0 is sunrise.

705.question: How many hunger points does a single slice of cake restore?
705.funFact: A whole cake has 7 slices and can be shared in peace, even if the hunger bar is full.

706.question: How many hearts of damage does a cactus deal per contact?
706.funFact: A cactus deals 1 health point, so half a heart, and makes items that touch it disappear.

707.question: How many gold nuggets do you need for a golden carrot (in addition to the carrot)?
707.funFact: The golden carrot is one of the best foods and brews a Potion of Night Vision with water bottles.

708.question: How many tipped arrows do you get from one lingering potion and 8 arrows?
708.funFact: The arrows' effect lasts an eighth as long as the potion. Lingering potions are made with dragon's breath.

709.question: With what percent base chance does a wither skeleton drop its skull?
709.funFact: With Looting the chance rises by 1 percentage point per level. For the Wither you need 3 such skulls.

710.question: How many iron ingots do you need for a bucket?
710.funFact: A bucket is built in a V shape from 3 iron ingots, just like a cauldron from 7 ingots.

711.question: How many iron ingots do you need for shears?
711.funFact: With shears you harvest leaves, wool, cobwebs and honeycombs without loss.

712.question: How many planks do you need for a boat?
712.funFact: Boats travel particularly fast on ice but do not break. They exist for every wood type.

713.question: How many blocks tall is a player (hitbox, without sneaking)?

714.funFact: This lets you walk just over the edge of a block without falling if you sneak.

715.question: How many diamonds do you need for a jukebox?
715.funFact: The jukebox is made from 8 planks and 1 diamond. Parrots dance to the music.

716.funFact: Pillars, stairs and slabs can be made from quartz blocks, a classic for bright builds.

3001.question: You can eat golden apples even when your hunger bar is full.
3001.funFact: True: Golden apples can always be eaten, even with a full hunger bar; they give Absorption and Regeneration.

3002.question: TNT can destroy obsidian.
3002.funFact: Myth: Obsidian has such a high blast resistance that TNT cannot destroy it.

3003.question: There are 128 strongholds in every world.
3003.funFact: True: They are spread out in rings around the world origin.

3004.question: Villagers only breed if there are enough beds and they have food.
3004.funFact: True: Without free beds there are no offspring.

3005.question: A hopper below a chest pulls out its contents.
3005.funFact: True: It takes items from the container above it.

3006.question: A pumpkin on your head limits the player's view.
3006.funFact: True: An overlay covers the screen.

3007.question: The netherite upgrade smithing template can be duplicated with diamonds.
3007.funFact: True: You also need netherrack and the template itself.

3008.question: An end portal frame consists of twelve frame blocks.
3008.funFact: True: Each one needs an eye of ender.

3009.question: A sheep named “jeb_” constantly changes its wool color.
3009.funFact: True: It is a nod to the developer Jens “Jeb” Bergensten.

3010.question: The Java Edition of Minecraft is written in C++.
3010.funFact: Myth: The Java Edition is written in Java, the Bedrock Edition in C++.

3011.question: The same seeds create different worlds in Java and Bedrock.

3012.question: There are ten obsidian towers on the main island of the End.
3012.funFact: True: End crystals sit on top of them.

3013.question: A bee dies after stinging a player.
3013.funFact: True: In the Java Edition the bee dies after its sting.

3014.question: Whoever kills a pillager captain later triggers a raid when entering a village.
3014.funFact: True: The captain grants the Bad Omen effect; the raid only begins when you enter a village with this effect.

3015.question: A villager struck by lightning turns into a witch.
3015.funFact: True: A lightning strike turns villagers into witches.

3016.question: An iron golem drops emeralds when it dies.
3016.funFact: Myth: It drops iron ingots and poppies.

3017.question: Wither skeletons spawn in nether fortresses.
3017.funFact: True: You need their skulls for the Wither.

3018.question: Minecraft was started by Markus “Notch” Persson.
3018.funFact: True: The first version was released in 2009.

3019.question: Skeletons flee from wolves.
3019.funFact: True: Skeletons and strays avoid wolves and run away from them.

3020.question: Villagers trade with gold ingots instead of emeralds.

3021.question: A shulker box keeps its contents when you break it.
3021.funFact: True: The contents stay stored in the item.

3022.question: Beds explode in the Nether.
3022.funFact: True: Beds explode in the Nether and the End when you try to sleep in them.

3023.question: Sand floats in the air if there is no block beneath it.
3023.funFact: Myth: Sand and gravel fall down.

3024.question: A spawner only produces monsters when a player is nearby.

3025.question: Mobs only spawn at night.
3025.funFact: Myth: Monsters also spawn in the dark during the day.

3026.question: Bedrock cannot be broken in survival mode.
3026.funFact: True: It forms the bottom of the world and the ceiling of the Nether.

3027.question: One tick lasts 0.05 seconds.
3027.funFact: True: The game runs at 20 ticks per second.

3028.question: The creeper came from a mistake while trying to model a pig.
3028.funFact: True: Notch mixed up the height and length of the pig model; the mistake became the creeper.

3029.question: You can also find diamonds in the Nether.
3029.funFact: Myth: There are no diamonds in the Nether, only ancient debris.

3030.question: Librarians can offer Mending books.
3030.funFact: True: They sell random enchanted books.

3031.question: The world spawn is always exactly at the coordinates 0, 0.
3031.funFact: Myth: It is only near 0, 0 and is determined randomly.

3033.question: If you mine ice without Silk Touch, water can appear in its place.
3033.funFact: True: Without Silk Touch, mined ice turns into water if there is a block or a liquid below it.

3034.question: Glowstone dust strengthens potions, redstone extends them.
3034.funFact: True: The ingredients have these fixed roles.

3035.question: Milk only removes negative effects.
3035.funFact: Myth: Milk removes all effects, including positive ones.

3036.question: A honey bottle cures poison.
3036.funFact: True: It removes the poison status.

3037.question: A zombie can break through wooden doors on Hard.
3037.funFact: True: On Hard difficulty zombies can break down wooden doors.

3038.question: A player can mine nether quartz ore in the Nether.

3039.question: A creeper still explodes even if it is killed by an arrow.
3039.funFact: Myth: If a creeper dies first, it does not explode; only an ignition that has already started runs out.

3040.question: Frogs live mostly in swamps and mangrove swamps.
3040.funFact: True: Their color depends on the biome.

3041.question: Pistons can push at most twelve blocks.
3041.funFact: True: With more blocks the piston does not move.

3042.question: You can grow wheat in the Nether.
3042.funFact: Myth: In the Nether, nether wart grows on soul sand.

3043.question: A piston can move obsidian.
3043.funFact: Myth: Obsidian cannot be moved by pistons.

3044.question: You need carrots for a cake.
3044.funFact: Myth: You need wheat, sugar, eggs and milk.

3045.question: Pandas spawn in bamboo jungles.
3045.funFact: True: They can be fed with bamboo.

3046.question: Dark forests can contain woodland mansions.
3046.funFact: True: Woodland mansions are rare and generate in dark forests and the pale garden.

3047.question: Water flows infinitely far.
3047.funFact: Myth: Water only flows about seven blocks.

3048.question: Mushroom stew cannot be stacked.
3048.funFact: True: All soups and stews do not stack.

3049.question: Pandas live in taigas.
3049.funFact: Myth: They live in bamboo jungles.

3050.question: A compass always points north.
3050.funFact: Myth: It points to the world spawn point.

3051.question: Piglins trade gold ingots for diamonds.
3051.funFact: Myth: Bartering gives random items such as ender pearls or obsidian, but no diamonds.

3052.question: The elder guardian gives Mining Fatigue.
3052.funFact: True: The effect hits players near ocean monuments.

3053.question: Shearing a sheep always gives exactly three wool.
3053.funFact: Myth: Each shearing gives 1 to 3 wool.

3054.question: A cake has seven slices.
3054.funFact: True: Each slice of cake restores 2 hunger points.

3055.question: A furnace gives experience when smelting.
3055.funFact: True: The experience is given when you take out the result.

3056.question: Badlands have additional gold ore.
3056.funFact: True: Gold also appears at higher altitudes there.

3057.question: Ancient debris also occurs in the Overworld.
3057.funFact: Myth: It only generates in the Nether.

3058.question: Copper never oxidizes.
3058.funFact: Myth: Copper oxidizes over time; wax stops that.

3059.question: TNT underwater does not destroy blocks.
3059.funFact: True: The explosion still damages living things there.

3060.question: Magma blocks do not burn players who sneak.
3060.funFact: True: You take no damage when sneaking on a magma block.

3061.question: Sleeping does not work when hostile monsters are nearby.

3062.question: A lodestone makes a compass point to it.

3063.question: You need nether wart for an awkward potion.
3063.funFact: True: It is the base of almost all potions.

3064.question: You can ride through lava on a strider.
3064.funFact: True: You need a saddle and a warped fungus on a stick.

3065.question: Emerald ore can be mined with a stone pickaxe.
3065.funFact: Myth: You need at least an iron pickaxe.

3066.question: On Hard, a villager killed by zombies always becomes a zombie villager.
3066.funFact: True: On Normal it is only a 50% chance.

3067.question: The Wither is summoned from soul sand (or soul soil) and three wither skeleton skulls.

3069.question: Elytra can be crafted.
3069.funFact: Myth: Elytra can only be found in end ships.

3070.question: With a full hunger bar you regenerate health faster.
3070.funFact: True: From 18 hunger points on, health regenerates.

3071.question: Cacti only grow on sand and red sand.
3071.funFact: True: In addition, no solid block may be next to them.

3072.question: Signs can be stacked up to 16.

3073.question: Nether fortresses contain guardians.
3073.funFact: Myth: They contain blazes and wither skeletons.

3074.question: An invisibility potion also makes worn armor invisible.
3074.funFact: Myth: Armor and held items stay visible.

3075.question: The Wild Update added the Wither.

3076.question: Axolotls can be caught with a water bucket.

3078.question: Fortune increases the yield of obsidian.
3078.funFact: Myth: Obsidian always drops exactly one block.

3079.question: Ancient cities lie deep underground.

3081.question: Axolotls were added in 1.16.
3081.funFact: Myth: They came with 1.17 (Caves & Cliffs Part 1).

3082.question: A Potion of Healing needs sugar.
3082.funFact: Myth: You need a glistering melon slice.

3083.question: Mojang is based in Germany.

3084.question: Strongholds contain an end portal.
3084.funFact: True: The end portal in the stronghold leads to the End.

3085.question: Pistons cannot move players or mobs.
3085.funFact: Myth: Pistons also push living things.

3086.question: Flowing lava that meets water turns into obsidian.
3086.funFact: Myth: Only lava source blocks turn into obsidian; flowing lava turns into cobblestone.

3087.question: A creeper does not explode when standing in water.
3087.funFact: Myth: It also explodes in water, but the surrounding blocks stay intact.

3088.question: Desert temples with a TNT trap often stand in deserts.
3088.funFact: True: TNT lies under the floor.

3089.question: Sand turns into stone in a furnace.
3089.funFact: Myth: Sand turns into glass in a furnace.

3090.question: Sugar cane can be eaten directly.
3090.funFact: Myth: Sugar cane is not edible.

3091.question: Gold ore can be mined with a stone pickaxe.
3091.funFact: Myth: You need at least an iron pickaxe.

3092.question: Minecraft is one of the best-selling video games of all time.

3094.question: Poisonous potatoes only sometimes cause poison.

3095.question: You can catch enchanted books while fishing.
3095.funFact: True: They are among the treasures.

3096.question: Emerald ore is only found in mountain biomes.
3096.funFact: True: It generates there as single blocks.

3097.question: The Curse of Vanishing makes the item disappear on death.

3100.funFact: Myth: The woodland explorer map is sold by a cartographer.

3101.funFact: Myth: You need a golden carrot.

3103.question: Thorns also damages the wearer's armor.

3104.question: Elytra and shields came with 1.9, the Combat Update.
3104.funFact: True: As did the off-hand system.

3105.question: Sugar cane needs water directly next to the block it stands on.
3105.funFact: True: This applies to sand, dirt, grass and similar ground.

3106.question: Mending uses experience to repair items.
3106.funFact: True: Collected experience orbs repair equipped items.

3107.question: Nether quartz ore can only be mined with a diamond pickaxe.

3108.question: Mangrove swamps contain villages.
3108.funFact: Myth: There are no villages there, only mangroves.

3109.question: A pig struck by lightning turns into a zombified piglin.
3109.funFact: True: Villagers are also transformed by lightning: into witches.

3110.question: In Hardcore the world is deleted after death, or you become a spectator.
3110.funFact: True: The difficulty is locked to Hard.

3111.question: There is a white rabbit called “The Killer Bunny” that attacks players.
3111.funFact: True: This rabbit only appears via a command and attacks players.

3112.question: Snowballs and eggs only stack up to 16.
3112.funFact: True: Ender pearls, signs and banners also stack up to 16.

3113.question: Dolphins can lead players to treasure.
3113.funFact: True: Fed dolphins lead to shipwrecks or ruins.

3114.question: Lapis lazuli ore gives several lapis lazuli per block.

3115.question: Netherite came with update 1.17.
3115.funFact: Myth: Netherite came with the Nether Update 1.16.

3116.question: Shulkers drop shulker shells.
3116.funFact: True: You craft shulker boxes from them.

3117.question: In the Nether, one block equals eight blocks in the Overworld.
3117.funFact: True: That makes Nether travel a shortcut.

3118.question: Glow squids spawn near ocean monuments.
3118.funFact: Myth: They spawn in dark underwater caves, not at monuments.

3119.question: Ancient debris is most common around Y=15 in the Nether.
3119.funFact: True: The peak is around Y=15.

3120.question: Diamond ore cannot be mined with an iron pickaxe.
3120.funFact: Myth: Iron pickaxes are enough for diamond ore.

3122.question: An observer switches when a player walks past in front of it.
3122.funFact: Myth: Observers only react to block changes, not to players.

3123.question: Wolves can be tamed with meat.
3123.funFact: Myth: Taming only works with bones; meat feeds and breeds them.

3124.question: Cats are tamed with bones.
3124.funFact: Myth: Cats are tamed with raw cod or raw salmon; bones are for wolves.

3125.question: Blazes take damage from snowballs.
3125.funFact: True: Snowballs hurt blazes; snow golems, on the other hand, take no damage from snowballs.

3126.question: An enderman has only 20 health points.

3127.question: Flint and steel has 64 durability.
3127.funFact: True: You use it to light fires and nether portals.

3128.question: Soul Speed only works on soul sand and soul soil.
3128.funFact: True: It increases your speed there.

3130.question: A killed Wither drops a nether star.
3130.funFact: True: You can use it to build a beacon.

3131.question: The Ender Dragon drops a dragon egg every time it dies.
3131.funFact: Myth: The dragon egg only appears when the dragon is defeated for the first time.

3133.question: Full version 1.0 was released in 2009.
3133.funFact: Myth: Full version 1.0 was released in November 2011.

3134.question: With a carved pumpkin on your head you can look at endermen without provoking them.
3134.funFact: True: The pumpkin prevents aggression from eye contact.

3135.question: The dragon egg teleports when you click it.
3135.funFact: True: You have to move it with a piston or other tricks.

3136.question: Mangrove swamps were added in 1.18.
3136.funFact: Myth: They came with the Wild Update 1.19.

3137.question: Potions can be stacked up to 16.

3139.question: The golden carrot is one of the most filling foods.
3139.funFact: True: It has a very high saturation.

3140.question: Iron doors cannot be opened by hand.
3140.funFact: True: They only open with a redstone signal.

3141.question: Wool dampens vibrations and so helps against sculk sensors.

3142.question: A zombie villager can be cured with a bucket of milk.
3142.funFact: Myth: You need a Potion of Weakness and a golden apple.

3143.question: The End and the Ender Dragon came with version 1.0.
3143.funFact: True: That was the full release in 2011.

3144.question: Llamas are tamed with wheat.
3144.funFact: Myth: Llamas are tamed by repeatedly trying to ride them.

3145.question: Piglins become aggressive if you are not wearing golden armor.
3145.funFact: True: At least one piece of golden armor calms them.

3146.question: A charged creeper always drops its own head when it dies.
3146.funFact: Myth: The explosion of a charged creeper makes other killed mobs drop their heads, not its own.

3147.question: A target block gives signals of different strength depending on how close to the center it is hit.
3147.funFact: True: A hit in the center gives signal strength 15.

3148.question: A deflected ghast fireball can kill the ghast.
3148.funFact: True: Hits from its own fireball hurt it badly.

3149.question: Pigs can only be fed and bred with carrots.
3149.funFact: Myth: Potatoes and beetroots also work for pigs.

3150.question: Elytra can be enchanted at an anvil with enchanted books.
3150.funFact: True: This does not work directly at the enchanting table; durability and mending come from books at the anvil.

3152.question: An iron golem has 50 health points.

3153.question: Normal spiders only attack in daylight if you provoke them.
3153.funFact: True: In bright light spiders are neutral, at night hostile.

3155.question: Ocelots are tamed with bones.
3155.funFact: Myth: Ocelots are made trusting with raw cod or salmon, and turn into cats in the process.

3156.question: Frogs eat small magma cubes and drop froglights.
3156.funFact: True: The froglight has a different color depending on the frog.

3157.question: The wandering trader is accompanied by llamas.
3157.funFact: True: He leads two trader llamas.

3158.question: End crystals heal the Ender Dragon.
3158.funFact: True: You have to destroy them to weaken the dragon.

3159.question: Hoglins turn into zoglins in the Overworld.
3159.funFact: True: Outside the Nether they become zoglins.

3161.question: A comparator can read the fill level of a chest.
3161.funFact: True: It outputs a signal depending on how full the container is.

3162.question: Netherite items do not burn in lava.
3162.funFact: True: They are fireproof and float in lava.

3163.question: Lingering potions are made with dragon's breath.
3163.funFact: True: You need a splash potion and dragon's breath.

3164.question: Suspicious stew always gives the same effect.
3164.funFact: Myth: The effect depends on the flower used.

3165.question: A shield can block arrows.
3165.funFact: True: Melee attacks can also be blocked.

3166.question: Camels can carry two players at the same time.
3166.funFact: True: Two seats: one in front, one behind.

3167.question: Copper is often found in dripstone caves in the Overworld.
3167.funFact: True: Copper ore commonly occurs in dripstone caves.

3168.question: A creeper struck by lightning becomes charged.
3168.funFact: True: Charged creepers have a much stronger explosion.

3169.question: Phantoms were added in 1.13.
3169.funFact: True: The Update Aquatic also brought dolphins and turtles.

3170.question: Soul sand slows down players and mobs.
3170.funFact: True: Soul soil, on the other hand, does not slow you down.

3171.question: You can eat raw mushrooms directly.
3171.funFact: Myth: Mushrooms are not edible, only in stews.

3172.question: The film “A Minecraft Movie” was released in 2025.
3172.funFact: True: Jack Black plays the lead as Steve.

3173.question: Fermented spider eye turns some potions into their opposite.
3173.funFact: True: For example, Swiftness becomes Slowness.

3174.question: The Wild Update was version 1.19.
3174.funFact: True: It brought the Warden, frogs and mangrove swamps.

3175.question: Phantoms appear when you have not slept for several nights.
3175.funFact: True: After three in-game nights without sleep, phantoms start to spawn.

3176.question: Ghasts also spawn in the Overworld, for example in large caves.
3176.funFact: Myth: Ghasts only spawn in the Nether.

3177.question: Enchanted golden apples can be crafted.
3177.funFact: Myth: Since 1.9 there has been no recipe for them.

3178.question: Horses are tamed with apples.
3178.funFact: Myth: Horses are tamed by repeatedly mounting them; apples only heal them.

3179.question: Redstone torches can burn out if they switch very quickly.
3179.funFact: True: If it is clocked too fast, the torch briefly burns out.

3180.question: The Potion of the Turtle Master slows you down and protects you at the same time.
3180.funFact: True: It gives strong Slowness and Resistance.

3181.question: A daylight detector can be switched to night.
3181.funFact: True: A right-click switches between day and night mode.

3182.question: A Potion of Healing harms the undead.
3182.funFact: True: The undead are hurt by healing.

3183.question: Mobs named “Dinnerbone” or “Grumm” stand upside down.
3183.funFact: True: The name tag trick turns mobs upside down.

3184.question: Iron golems can be healed with iron ingots.
3184.funFact: True: A right-click with an iron ingot repairs the golem.

3185.question: A zombie with a helmet does not burn in sunlight right away.
3185.funFact: True: The helmet protects from the sun but loses durability.

3186.question: A furnace smelts iron ore even without fuel.

3187.question: Netherite armor gives no knockback resistance.
3187.funFact: Myth: Netherite armor gives knockback resistance.

3189.question: Throwing an ender pearl causes no damage.
3189.funFact: Myth: The landing costs 5 health points (2.5 hearts).

3190.question: A campfire under a bee nest stops bees from getting angry when you harvest honey.

3192.question: Ten obsidian blocks are enough for a nether portal.
3192.funFact: True: The four corners are not needed.

3193.question: Fortune increases the yield of diamond ore.
3193.funFact: True: It also works on coal, lapis, redstone and emerald.

3194.question: The Wither was introduced in version 1.4.
3194.funFact: True: That was in 2012 in update 1.4 (the Pretty Scary Update).

3195.question: Sweet berries grow in the desert.
3195.funFact: Myth: Sweet berry bushes grow in taigas.

3196.question: A smithing table is needed for netherite upgrades.

3197.question: A zombified piglin never attacks, even if you attack it.
3197.funFact: Myth: Zombified piglins become aggressive if you attack one of them.

3198.question: An enchanted golden apple makes players immortal.
3198.funFact: Myth: It gives strong effects, but no immortality.

3199.question: Lava flows just as far in the Overworld as in the Nether.
3199.funFact: Myth: In the Overworld lava flows a shorter distance.

3200.question: Iron golems always attack players.
3200.funFact: Myth: They are neutral and only attack players if the players attack them or villagers.

3201.question: A stone pressure plate also reacts to items lying on it.
3201.funFact: Myth: Stone pressure plates only react to players and mobs, wooden plates also to items.

3202.question: Ender pearls can be stacked up to 64.
3202.funFact: Myth: Ender pearls only stack up to 16.

3203.question: An anvil always stays undamaged when used.
3203.funFact: Myth: With each use it can be damaged with a certain probability and eventually breaks.

3204.question: Packed ice does not melt by itself.
3204.funFact: True: Regular ice melts at a high light level; packed ice and blue ice do not.

3205.question: Diamond tools last longer than netherite tools.
3205.funFact: Myth: Netherite has the higher durability.

3206.question: A netherite ingot needs netherite scrap and gold ingots.
3206.funFact: True: The recipe is four scrap and four gold.

3208.question: Honey blocks make players faster.
3208.funFact: Myth: Honey blocks slow down movement and jumping.

3210.question: Splash potions are made by adding redstone.

3211.question: A Potion of Strength is brewed with sugar.

3213.question: The smoker smelts ores twice as fast.
3213.funFact: Myth: It only cooks food faster; ores are smelted by the blast furnace.

3214.question: Two lava sources create an infinite lava source.
3214.funFact: Myth: That only works with water.

3215.question: A beacon also works without a pyramid.
3215.funFact: Myth: A beacon needs at least a base pyramid of iron, gold, diamond, emerald or netherite blocks.

3216.question: Aqua Affinity makes you swim faster underwater.
3216.funFact: Myth: It speeds up mining underwater, not swimming.

3217.question: Endermen only occur in the End.
3217.funFact: Myth: Endermen also spawn in the Overworld and in the Nether.

3218.question: The Ender Dragon was already in the alpha version.
3218.funFact: Myth: The Ender Dragon came with 1.0 in 2011.

3219.question: Pumpkin pie needs carrots.
3219.funFact: Myth: You need pumpkin, sugar and an egg.

3221.question: The Wither has 200 health points in the Java Edition.
3221.funFact: Myth: It has 300 health points in the Java Edition.

3222.question: The Warden was added in version 1.17.
3222.funFact: Myth: The Warden came with the Wild Update 1.19.

3223.question: Wandering traders only show up in villages.
3223.funFact: Myth: They spawn near players and are not tied to villages.

3224.question: Ancient debris can be mined with an iron pickaxe.
3224.funFact: Myth: You need at least a diamond pickaxe.

3225.question: Redstone dust can be placed on glass.
3225.funFact: True: Since 1.14, redstone dust also lies on glass and other transparent blocks, as long as the top face is solid.

3226.question: Bread is crafted from sugar and wheat.
3226.funFact: Myth: Bread consists of three wheat.

3228.question: A totem of undying also saves you from falling into the void.
3228.funFact: Myth: The totem does not protect from death by the void.

3229.question: With Silk Touch you can mine a monster spawner and take it with you.
3229.funFact: Myth: Spawners cannot be collected, not even with Silk Touch.

3230.question: Copper was introduced in version 1.16.
3230.funFact: Myth: Copper came with update 1.17 (Caves & Cliffs, Part 1).

3231.question: Sculk blocks give no experience when mined.

3232.question: Bastion remnants are located in the Overworld.
3232.funFact: Myth: Bastion remnants are located in the Nether, not in the Overworld.

3233.question: Copper ore needs at least an iron pickaxe.
3233.funFact: Myth: A stone pickaxe is enough.

3234.question: Icebergs appear in the desert.
3234.funFact: Myth: Icebergs drift in cold oceans.

3235.question: The Warden finds its prey mainly with its eyes.
3235.funFact: Myth: The Warden is blind and relies on vibrations and smell.

3236.question: Herobrine is a normal mob in the game.
3236.funFact: Myth: Herobrine is a legend; Mojang confirms that he does not exist.

3237.question: Chickens take fall damage like other animals.
3237.funFact: Myth: Chickens take no fall damage and flutter slowly down.

3238.question: A wither skeleton drops netherite.
3238.funFact: Myth: It drops bones, coal and rarely its skull.

3239.question: The Ender Dragon has 100 health points.
3239.funFact: Myth: It has 200 health points (100 hearts).

3240.question: A normal cow turns into a mooshroom when struck by lightning.
3240.funFact: Myth: Lightning turns a red mooshroom into a brown one, but not a normal cow into a mooshroom.

3241.question: A spider jockey consists of a spider and a creeper.
3241.funFact: Myth: Spider jockeys consist of a spider and a skeleton.

3242.question: The blast furnace cooks food twice as fast.
3242.funFact: Myth: The blast furnace smelts ores and metal items faster; food is cooked by the smoker.

3244.question: Bees fill honey into their hive without having visited flowers first.
3244.funFact: Myth: Without nectar from flowers, no honey is made in a beehive or bee nest.

3245.question: There is a day-night cycle in the End.
3245.funFact: Myth: The End has a fixed sky.

3246.question: A raid is triggered by the Hero of the Village effect.
3246.funFact: Myth: The Bad Omen effect triggers the raid; Hero of the Village is the reward after winning.

3247.question: Lapis lazuli ore needs a diamond pickaxe.
3247.funFact: Myth: A stone pickaxe is enough.

3248.question: Sprinting does not use any extra hunger.

3249.question: A player bitten by a zombie turns into a zombie.
3249.funFact: Myth: Players do not turn into zombies.

3250.question: The crafting table has a grid of 4 by 4 slots.
3250.funFact: Myth: The crafting table has a 3 by 3 grid.

3251.question: Nitwits (villagers with a green robe) can trade.
3251.funFact: Myth: Nitwits have no profession and cannot trade.

3252.question: Normal spiders poison with their bite.

3253.question: A barrel holds more items than a chest.
3253.funFact: Myth: Both have 27 slots; a double chest has 54.

3255.question: Snowballs deal damage to players.
3255.funFact: Myth: Snowballs deal no damage to players, only knockback.

3256.question: Oak leaves always drop an apple when broken.
3256.funFact: Myth: Apples only drop with a low chance from oak and dark oak leaves.

3257.question: A bed only sets your spawn point if you sleep in it at night.
3257.funFact: Myth: A simple right-click on the bed sets your spawn point, even during the day.

3258.question: F3+B shows hitboxes.
3258.funFact: True: This works in the Java Edition.

3259.question: A compass points to the world spawn in all dimensions.
3259.funFact: Myth: In the Nether and the End the needle spins wildly.

3260.question: Phantoms spawn in the Nether.
3260.funFact: Myth: Phantoms only exist in the Overworld, when you have not slept for a long time.

3261.question: Lightning only occurs during thunderstorms.
3261.funFact: Myth: Lightning also happens with skeleton traps and the trident with Channeling.

3262.question: Since 1.18, diamonds are most common near the bottom of the world.
3262.funFact: True: Their frequency increases toward the bottom of the world.

3263.question: You can tie animals to fences with a lead.

3266.question: Shulkers can be found in nether fortresses.
3266.funFact: Myth: Shulkers live in end cities.

3267.question: A red mooshroom turns brown when struck by lightning.
3267.funFact: True: Brown mooshrooms can be fed flowers and then give suspicious stew.

3268.question: Parrots can imitate the sounds of other mobs.
3268.funFact: True: They imitate creepers, skeletons and many others.

3272.question: A sheep can only be sheared once.
3272.funFact: Myth: The wool grows back when the sheep eats grass.

3273.question: Iron golems can swim.
3273.funFact: Myth: Iron golems sink in water and cannot swim.

3274.question: No hostile mobs spawn on mushroom islands.
